name: Costco
tagline: The best-run retailer in America, at a price that leaves no room for error.
strengths: Membership model with very high renewal rates
weaknesses: Slower growth than its multiple implies
thesis: Consumer surplus: members get more value than they pay
moat: Cost advantage and scale, locked in by membership fees. Very durable.
outlook: A great business that's almost always priced as one. Keep it on the list for a sell-off.
changeMind: A broad market sell-off that brings the multiple down meaningfully
entryNote: Becomes interesting only after a large drop in the multiple.
method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
